title: Astrophysics Adventure 3: Hubble's law and the expanding universe
welcome_lead: Today you'll measure cosmic expansion with Hubble's law.
meta_desc: Physics — Hubble's law v = H₀d, redshift, Big Bang, CMB, age of universe.
final_note: You learned v = H₀d (H₀ ≈ 70 km/s/Mpc), redshift z = Δλ/λ; Big Bang ~13.8 Gyr ago; CMB confirms it; age ≈ 1/H₀.

concepts.def: The distance light travels in one year (~9.5×10¹⁵ m).

Light from distant galaxies stretched to longer wavelengths — the universe is expanding.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Hubble (1929) found galaxies recede with v proportional to distance:

v = H₀ · d

H₀ ≈ 70 km/s/Mpc.

Implication: space itself expands. Tracing back → all matter started together — Big Bang.

Spectral lines shift to longer λ as source recedes:

z = (λ_observed - λ_emitted) / λ_emitted

For v << c: z ≈ v/c.

Most distant galaxies have z > 10 (light emitted < 500 Myr after Big Bang).

Penzias + Wilson (1964) found a uniform 2.7 K microwave glow — relic radiation from when universe became transparent (~380,000 y after Big Bang). Nobel 1978.

Tiny anisotropies seeded today's galaxy structure.

Age of universe ≈ 1/H₀ ≈ 14 Gyr. Latest WMAP/Planck: 13.8 Gyr.

Open questions: dark matter (~27%), dark energy (~68%). Less than 5% of universe is ordinary matter.

mcqs.q: What produces a magnetic field around a wire?
options: The metal in the wire is naturally magnetic.
The voltage across the wire creates magnetism.
A moving electric charge — i.e. an electric current.
No — it is caused by dust in space absorbing blue light.

mcqs.q: What is the threshold frequency in the photoelectric effect?
options: The minimum frequency of light required to eject electrons from a given metal — it equals the work function divided by Planck's constant.
The frequency at which photons travel at the speed of light.
No — it is caused by dust in space absorbing blue light.
The minimum intensity of light needed to eject electrons.

mcqs.q: Is the cosmological redshift of distant galaxies a true Doppler shift?
options: No — it is caused by dust in space absorbing blue light.
The voltage across the wire creates magnetism.
No — it arises from the expansion of space stretching photon wavelengths during transit, not from the galaxy's motion through space.
Yes — it is the same Doppler shift as a moving siren on Earth.
